packageRules.description: Hold tree-sitter (crate) and tree-sitter-cli (npm) on 0.26.x. Zed compiles the grammar's committed src/parser.c itself, and a parser generated by a newer CLI can carry a language ABI that Zed's bundled runtime rejects, which silently breaks highlighting for every user. Lift this only after Zed stable ships a runtime that accepts the newer ABI.

Hold zed_extension_api on 0.7.x. 0.7.0 is the newest version Zed stable accepts (wasm_host/wit.rs caps Stable/Preview at since_v0_6_0::MAX_VERSION); an extension built against a newer API fails to load. See the comment in extension/Cargo.toml.
Batch routine Cargo minor and patch updates across all three Cargo roots into one PR.
Batch routine npm minor and patch updates into one PR.
Batch routine GitHub Actions minor and patch updates into one PR.

Keep tree-sitter-cli out of the npm batch. The committed src/ (parser.c, grammar.json, node-types.json) must be regenerated with the exact CLI in package-lock.json, and CI fails with 'src/ is stale' otherwise; even 0.26.11 -> 0.26.13 changes parser.c. Each bump needs 'tree-sitter generate' run and the result committed on the PR branch.
